_comment: Trust policy for the fde-sor Lambda execution role. Attach as the role's AssumeRolePolicyDocument (this is NOT a permissions policy -- see sor-lambda-permissions-policy.json for that). The aws:SourceAccount condition pins the role to THIS account so a Lambda in a different account cannot assume a role that holds a customer's system-of-record credentials. Replace ${AWS_ACCOUNT_ID} at deploy time; fde_sor/deploy/sor_lambdas.py does not templatize this file, deliberately -- rendering it belongs to the pipeline that knows the account, and the four functions can legitimately share one role or have four, depending on how far you take least privilege.
